column1: # V-009 (i-e) probe_ctl.S (gen_ctl.py) section V, QEMU 10.1.0, VLEN 128 ELEN 64 — as RANGES
# since (i-f): each line is a run of consecutive keys FIRST..LAST (inclusive) with one
# result, and each form ends with HASH, the FNV-1a-64 of the expanded rows ("KEY RESULT\n",
# the keys spelled as here, in order), so the expansion is checked as well as the ranges.
# Results: trap (cause 2) | vill (rd = 0, vl = 0, vtype = 1<<63) | the vl (rd = vl, vtype
# = the requested vtype). Forms: vsetvli-max = vsetvli t0, x0, KEY; vsetivli-31 = vsetivli
# t0, 31, KEY; vsetvl-e64m1|bit = vsetvl t0, t1(31), t2(0x18 | 1 << KEY); vsetvl-f7 = the
# word with bits 31:25 = KEY, rd t0, rs1 t1(31), rs2 t2(0x18). These are QEMU's readings,
# not a rule: the rule is what is under test (yantra::vector::vlmax_of).
